testTitle: Weekly regular-rate averaging
testDescription: Compute each employee's regular rate, the weekly average hourly rate across all hours worked, which is the base for overtime and paid-break pay. For piece-rate workers it differs per person and changes every day as pieces accumulate.

testTitle: California daily overtime
testDescription: Apply California daily overtime: time-and-a-half after 8 hours and double time after 10 in a workday, computed on the regular rate. The two overtime types must be tagged distinctly for the export.

testTitle: Weekly overtime
testDescription: Apply weekly overtime after 40 regular hours in the workweek, alongside the daily rule. The two interact so hours are not counted twice.

testTitle: Break-premium recalculation
testDescription: Recompute paid-break pay as the weekly average rate moves through the week, since breaks are paid at that average. This is circular: a new day's pieces change the average, which changes prior breaks, which changes the weekly total.

testTitle: Weekly minimum-wage guarantee on piece
testDescription: Guarantee that piece-rate earnings meet at least minimum wage averaged across the week, topping up if they fall short. A single day below minimum is acceptable if the week as a whole clears it.

testTitle: Decimal-rounding reconciliation
testDescription: Reconcile the day's minute total to decimal hours so a full 8-hour day reads 8.00, not 7.99, since minutes convert to repeating decimals. The fix adjusts the day's last job card.

testTitle: Meal-penalty calculation
testDescription: Detect short, late, or missed meals against the California thresholds and add a one-hour penalty on a Non Labor penalty job, honoring any waivers. The penalty job carries its own earning code so it exports cleanly.

testTitle: Finalize gross pay
testDescription: Confirm every crew has transferred cleanly for the week and treat the job cards as the payroll basis. The payroll summary report is the usual final check.

testTitle: Payroll export file
testDescription: Generate the payroll file in the customer's accounting format and hand it to the accounting system, which runs its own paycheck calculation. Always preview with a test file first to catch missing earning codes.

testTitle: Reverse export
testDescription: Undo a completed export so its job cards can be corrected and re-exported, distinct from simply re-sending the same file. Reversing un-marks the cards; re-sending just pushes the file again.

testTitle: H2A offered-hours reporting
testDescription: Track and report offered versus worked hours for H2A visa workers separately, as their guarantee requires. Parked for Anthony (H2A module off).

testTitle: Department and multi-state overtime split
testDescription: Apply different overtime rules and group results by department, which is how multi-state operators run per-state rules. Anthony uses departments even within a single state.
